title: Verify: Scene layer ordering, entity creation and visibility unit tests via @game
summary: Suite asserts ordering, one sprite per object and visibleWhen using @game imports and a fake RenderContext.
description: Context: ACT-B confirmed buildScene and SceneObject behavior. Desired behavior: a suite asserts ordering, entity creation and visibility through @game with a fake RenderContext. Expected result: three tests pass. Why: proves REQ-B from the spec.
acceptance_criteria: createSprite called once per object with asset, position, scale
setVisible gets false then true as flag toggles

steps.action: Import buildScene from '@game/engine/buildScene', SceneObject from '@game/entities/SceneObject', layerDepth/LAYER_ORDER from '@game/engine/layers', createInitialState/setFlag from '@game/state/gameState', validScene from './fixtures/valid-world'. Build a fake RenderContext whose createSprite returns vi.fn handle. Tests: (1) objects authored out of order yield ascending depth array; (2) createSprite call count equals scene.objects.length with key/x/y/scale matching spec; (3) object with visibleWhen: sync(state without flag) then sync(setFlag) gives setVisible calls [[false],[true]]
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sceneAliasBuild.test.ts
steps.expected: All three tests pass, no real Phaser loaded
